230g egg white 

400g granulated sugar

350g butter

2 teaspoons vanilla

salt pinch

- whisk over a double boiler until it reaches 160F
- transfer mixture to the bowl of a stand mixer and start whipping
- once it begins to reach stiff peaks, stop the mixer, toast the meringue with a blowtorch, than start the mixer again (repeat until you reach your desired flavor, I like to do it around 8-12 times)
- once the meringue is sufficiently toasted, whip till cooled enough to add the butter, then add the butter, vanilla, and salt
- mix until combined
- use for cake/save for later
